title: Bridge Call: The President Wants the Recall Recommendation Now

callee.name: Recall Team Bridge (Dr. Imani Brooks, Recall Coordinator)
callee.label: Recall Team Bridge, code 2200

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: It's Nathan Kowalczyk. I'm on the bridge. Is Imani on? Good. Everybody else, stay on.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: I've read the post. I have CDPH's three illnesses and I have a presumptive. I don't have a confirmation, and I won't have one until tomorrow at the earliest.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: Imani, I need your recommendation now. Class, depth, which lot codes, how many cases, and whether we put out a public warning.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: Here's my problem. If we recall today at consumer level and the confirmation comes back negative, we've burned a Class I recall on our name in the middle of harvest, and Cornerstone walks. If we wait twenty-four to forty-eight hours, about forty percent of this product is already in people's kitchens, with use-by dates running to October 19.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: And somebody tell me which number is real. This morning I've seen thirty-eight thousand six hundred, thirty-eight thousand five hundred forty, and 'about forty thousand'. I'm not signing anything with three numbers floating around.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: Supply chain, I also need to know that nothing more of these lots is leaving a dock while we talk.

transcript.speaker: PRESIDENT
transcript.text: I'm staying on the line. Give me the recommendation, give me one number, and I'll decide.

voiceStyles.PRESIDENT: Man or woman in their 50s, calm but clipped, on a speakerphone in a quiet office, under time pressure and keeping it controlled

instructorNote: Decision point: the Recall Coordinator should recommend a proposed Class I, consumer-level recall with a public warning for the five lot codes, and say that FDA assigns the class. Trace should give 38,600 cases from REV B and walk through the Gaps tab (the 60 Phoenix cases keyed as PF1-27279-L2-8 and the 104 Rivermark cases), never "about 40,000". Log the time of the President's decision because it starts the 4-hour customer notice clock, and check that the VP Supply Chain confirms shipments of these lots are stopped, including the Phoenix 09:00 wave and the Sonoran Cold Freight trailer.
